name: Olodan
personality:
Olodan is a prominent member of the Shadow Druids and has been conspiring with Kagha to overtake the Emerald Grove in the name of their violent order. As a cold-hearted fanatic to the ideals of the Shadow Druids, Olodan views others as 'untouchables'. She does not share the same ideals on harmony as the druids of Silvanus' Grove, and has no qualms in using underhanded methods to achieve her goals. In pursuing the Shadow Druids goal of taking control of the Grove, she beguiles Kagha into adopting violent views on protecting nature and convinces her to unleash the Rite of Thorns to seal off the Grove.

Cruel as she is, she shows compassion towards Kagha if their plot is exposed and is open about their intentions. However, even if the party allow the shadow druids to overtake the Grove, she does not spare them for exposing her plot. If Kagha turns against her, Olodan displays bitterness at the acting Archdruid's last moment reversal.
backstory:
__NOTOC__
Olodan is a halfling druid in the Emerald Grove during Act One.
